title: Athletic Tour
description: 3-round athletic circuit combining strength, agility and endurance for a total effort

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + thoracic rotation + arm reaching to the sky

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Assisted pistol squat
exercises.instructions: Single-leg squat holding onto a support

exercises.name: Explosive push-ups
exercises.instructions: Push hard enough to lift hands off the floor

exercises.name: Glute bridge march
exercises.instructions: In a bridge, alternate lifting one leg then the other like marching

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs simultaneously to touch feet

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump forward for distance, absorb landing and repeat

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
